name: Get pull request creation cap for an org
description: Get pull request creation cap for an org Gets the pull request creation cap configuration for an organization. GET /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits/pulls/creation-cap
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits/pulls/creation-cap
Gets the pull request creation cap configuration for an organization. The cap limits the total number of open pull requests a user can have across all public repositories in the organization at one time. Only users with admin access to the organization can view the cap configuration.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

name: Get interaction restrictions for an organization
description: Get interaction restrictions for an organization Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with this organization and when the restriction expires. GET /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits
Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with this organization and when the restriction expires. If there is no restrictions, you will see an empty response.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

name: Remove interaction restrictions for an organization
description: Remove interaction restrictions for an organization Removes all interaction restrictions from public repositories in the given organization. DELETE /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits
context:
DELETE /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits
Removes all interaction restrictions from public repositories in the given organization. You must be an organization owner to remove restrictions.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

name: Set interaction restrictions for an organization
description: Set interaction restrictions for an organization Temporarily restricts interactions to a certain type of GitHub user in any public repository in the given organization. PUT /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits
context:
PUT /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits
Temporarily restricts interactions to a certain type of GitHub user in any public repository in the given organization. You must be an organization owner to set these restrictions. Setting the interaction limit at the organization level will overwrite any interaction limits that are set for individual repositories owned by the organization.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Update pull request creation cap for an org
description: Update pull request creation cap for an org Updates the pull request creation cap for an organization. PATCH /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits/pulls/creation-cap
context:
PATCH /orgs/{org}/interaction-limits/pulls/creation-cap
Updates the pull request creation cap for an organization. The cap limits the total number of open pull requests a user can have across all public repositories in the organization at one time. Only users with admin access to the organization can configure the cap.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)
